item.title: Chery Vaults Over Competition As Philippines' Best-Selling Plug-In Hybrid Brand
item.description: United Asia Automotive Group Inc. (UAAGI), the official distributor of Chery automobiles in the Philippines, is topping industry sales charts for plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs). Their strong performance is attributed to the all-new Tiggo rEV CD-M 7-seater PHEV SUV which recently saw the release of a new Luxury Edition (LE) variant.Read More »

item.title: Honda Cars PH Still Won't Offer The City Hybrid; They'll Go Full Electric Instead
item.description: Honda Cars Philippines has effectively ruled out launching the City e:HEV at least for the entirety of 2026. This was confirmed by Ms. Rie Miyake, president of Honda Cars Philippines, during the 2025 Honda Fest.Read More »

item.title: BMW Philippines Offering Big Discounts On i5 eDrive40 Executive Shuttle Units
item.description: Following the conclusion of the 2025 FIVB Men’s World Championship in Manila last September 12 to 28, BMW has completed its role as the event’s Official Premium Mobility Partner. Throughout the tournament, which brought the world’s elite volleyball nations to the country, BMW provided a dedicated fleet of BMW i5 eDrive40 units to transport the Fédération Internationale de Volleyball (FIVB) top executives.Read More »
